en: New What's new: tap the sparkles at the top to see what this version added, with See more for every earlier version. After an update it shows once by itself.

Videl Pro now works on your phone: the same license as the desktop app unlocks batches of many files at once. Without it you get 5 free batch runs a day, up to 10 files each. One file at a time stays free with no limit.
Convert, Mute and Extract Audio take several files at once and do them one after another.
New Compress tool: make videos smaller in three quality steps.
New Watermark tool: put your text on a video.
New Metadata Scrubber: remove the location, device and other hidden details from a file before you share it.
A new look that matches the Videl web app.
When the quality you picked is no longer offered, the download falls back to the closest one instead of failing.
Download Spotify links.
X (Twitter) downloads work again.
Bug reports can include a screenshot.
Bug reports go through Videl's own server, so they arrive more reliably.
Updates download and install from inside the app.
New Report a Bug page in the menu.
Trimming a download is more reliable, and error messages can be copied to send to us.
Trimming a download fetches only the part you chose, so it is much faster.
The video preview plays straight from the link.
Download only part of a video by choosing a time range.
Preview a video before you download it.
Save downloads as MP3.
New Extract Audio tool: save the sound of a video as MP3, M4A, AAC, FLAC, WAV or OGG.
Convert takes audio and image files too.
Videl tells you when an update is available.
Trim works on audio too, with handles to drag the start and the end.
The first Videl for Android: download videos and audio from links, and Trim, Crop, Convert, Merge, Mute, GIF, Frame Grab and Hex Palette, all on your phone.
